CHHATRAPATI SHAHU JI MAHARAJ UNIVERSITY, KANPUR
KALYANPUR KANPUR -208024
1. Name of Position: Chief Executive Officer,
Educational Qualification and Experience: Candidate must hold Post Graduate or equivalent
degree in any discipline from recognized Institution with a minimum of 15 years’ extensive
experience in senior roles in entrepreneurial organizations. PhD or managerial experience in
Industry/public sector/ incubation center will be considered desirable. Incumbent should be
professionally qualified with a proven record of setting high standards in leadership roles.
Emoluments: a. Fixed Goss Emoluments: Rs 90000-125000
The contract will be for 1 year contract extendable to 3 to 5 years based on appraisal of
performance.
2. Name of Position: Senior Incubation Manager
Educational Qualification and Experience: Candidate must hold Post Graduate or equivalent
degree in any technical/science/engineering background from recognized Institution with
excellent academic record OR having a Bachelor degree any technical/science/engineering
background with minimum of 5 years’ experience in Incubation center management. Strong
track record of creating robust entrepreneurial ecosystem with experience in fund raising,
strategic planning, execution of incubation programs/ grants, networking and initiating
outreach programs will be desirable.
Emoluments: a. Fixed Goss Emoluments: Rs 70000-90000
The contract will be for 1 year contract extendable to 3 to 5 years based on appraisal of
performance.
3. Name of Position: Innovation Officer/ Incubation Manager
Educational Qualification and Experience: Candidate must hold Graduate or equivalent
degree in any discipline from recognized Institution, preferably Law and having a minimum of
2-3 years’ managerial experience in Start Up- Ecosystem/ incubator centre management in all
sectors. Organizational experience for training programs, accounts and compliance, legal,
policy industry linkage and fostering entrepreneurship and project management will be
desirable.
Emoluments: a. Fixed Goss Emoluments: Rs 50000-60000
The contract will be for 1 year contract extendable to 3 to 5 years based on appraisal of
performance.
Application forms can be obtained from Recruitment at www.csjmu.ac.in, Last date of application is
10 days from Date of Advertisement. Hard copy of application may be sent through Speed Post to
Registrar, CSJM University, Kanpur 208024, UP, India
Ref. CSJMIF/2022/ Recruitment-01 Date: 05-06-2022
